subject: Next steps & demo scheduling for Acme Analytics - availability
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Johnson <alicia@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Lai <ben.lai@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: Next steps & demo scheduling

Hi Alicia — great to speak this morning. Quick recap from today's discovery and suggested next steps so we can line up a demo + tech deep-dive: 

Key takeaways:
- You want an inference platform that reduces per-token cost and provides predictable latency for real-time customer-facing features.
- Primary P0 workload: chat-based product search (1.2M queries/month, 150 tokens/resp avg).
- Security: Sarah (security) will want to review data retention and audit logs; you also mentioned SOC2 evidence.

Proposed next steps:
1) Product demo (30–40m) with Camila to walk through runtime, routing, and cost controls.
2) Technical deep dive (45m) with Marissa to cover integration, network/KMS, and deployment options.
3) Mutual action plan + sample SOW draft attached for planning.

Suggested demo times (PT):
- Tue 2026-11-24 10:00–10:40 AM PT
- Wed 2026-11-25 9:00–9:40 AM PT
- Thu 2026-11-26 1:00–1:40 PM PT

Can you confirm which of those works best and who from your side should join each session? If Tuesday 11/24 works I can send a calendar invite with Zoom link and include Camila and Marissa.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (proposal template), redwood-product-one-pager.pdf

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123

Thanks Rafael — great call this morning. Tuesday 11/24 at 10:00 AM PT works for us. I'm looping in Sarah (security) and Ben (eng) — Sarah would like the technical deep dive to cover data retention, audit logs, and KMS options.

A quick note on attendees:
- Alicia Johnson (Product) — attending demo + decision maker
- Ben Lai (Engineering Lead) — attending demo + deep dive
- Sarah Kim (Security) — deep dive only, likely 45 minutes

If you can book Tue 11/24 10:00 AM PT for the demo and we can schedule the deep dive the same week (Wed or Thu) that would be ideal.

Best,
Alicia
